early.name: Monster Rounds
early.annotation: Skip if you want. Helps you kill all NPCs faster to gain wave prio and take jungle faster. Take less chip damage from all NPCs. Super good item.

early.name: Stalker
early.annotation: Good damage in lane + bonus health, keep in mind that the effect can ONLY be applied every 6 seconds for 5 seconds. Definitely worth replacing with another tier 2 gun item later on.

early.annotation: Very good spirit power (+ resist) increase item. Spirit power not only increases your damage but also your Blasted bonus HP scaling. Replace with Spirit Resilience later.

mid.name: Bullet Resist Shredder
mid.annotation: Resist, shred, and gets you 4.8k spirit. Synergizes well with Torment Pulse if you want it. If you're not an evil QSR abuser buy this instead.

mid.name: Rapid Recharge
mid.annotation: Bashdowns scale better now, but can be skipped for rushing late paths

late.name: Crushing Fists

late.name: Colossus
